protocol.closure: neighbors of new counterexample pivots, then gallop/binary all adjacent opposite observations
protocol.matched: offline diagnostic: uniform uses prune's actual exploration count
protocol.prune: one midpoint per eligible ordinary discard; first contradiction enters common closure
protocol.scope: fixed one-dimensional Slice; no real resolver/verifier, no full multi-coordinate scheduler, no projection
protocol.uniform: whole-domain unknown-candidate quantiles, one batch after mechanical search
